summary: Verified removal of the Kiosk button and kiosk overlay on /visual-agent-demo. Both on the plain URL and on ?kiosk=1, the Kiosk button ([data-testid=visual-agent-kiosk]) is absent, no button labelled 'Kiosk' exists, and the fullscreen overlay ([data-testid=visual-agent-kiosk-overlay]) does not render. The remaining controls (toggle-play, restart, Scripted/Live toggle) render intact and the page loads normally (hero, listings, etc.).
critical_code_review_comments: VisualAgentDemo.jsx uses '{false && kioskMode && (...)}' dead-code guard — works, but the entire kiosk overlay JSX and kioskMode state should be removed outright to reduce dead code and bundle size.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kiosk removal on /visual-agent-demo is confirmed. Page loads within 1s, hero + controls (Play/Pause, Restart, Scripted/Live, Ask by voice) render correctly. ?kiosk=1 does not activate the overlay (kioskMode forced false). Suggest E1 clean up the remaining dead kiosk overlay JSX in VisualAgentDemo.jsx.
